notes:
I'm a co-founder of DealNav.

Tagline: Map-based CRM for real estate acquisitions and brokerage teams.

DealNav is a map-based CRM for real estate acquisitions and brokerage professionals. Deals, contacts and follow-ups live as pins on one map, so a team can see and work its whole market in one place. Click any lot to open its county record (owner, mailing address, acreage, zoning, flood zone, year built, building size and last sale) and turn it into a tracked deal with the owner added as a contact. DealNav connects directly to ChatGPT and Claude on every plan, so a team can ask its AI assistant about its own pipeline. It's web-based and works on any computer, tablet or phone.

Features:
- Map with priority pins
- County parcel records and one-click deal creation from a parcel
- Deals as a list, Kanban board or pipeline report
- Contacts linked to deals, including LLC/entity contacts
- Reminders by email and text
- Gmail and Outlook email sync
- ChatGPT and Claude connection, plus a public API, on every plan
- Team datasets with view-only or edit access
- File uploads
- Spreadsheet import and Excel export

Integrations: Gmail, Outlook, ChatGPT, Claude, public API.
